data.title: 帕瓦 · 冬日毛毯里的任性温存
data.description: 暖炉旁的木地板上，穿着猫耳毛绒居家服的帕瓦将自己裹在厚毛毯里，伸手拽着身边人的衣角，嘴里嘟囔着嫌冷却不肯松手。
data.action: wrapped in fluffy blanket, holding sleeve, cute pout, flushed nose
data.lighting: warm glowing heater lamps creating rich amber atmosphere
data.promptProse: Snuggled on the living room rug wrapped in a plush blanket and comfy fleece hoodie, Power peers up with rosy cheeks and a slight pout, tugging gently on the viewer's sleeve for warmth.
data.animaCaption: Power wrapped in a fluffy blanket, tugging a sleeve with a cute pout.
